notes: Hard: the task must meet the highest competency floor in the family (C-c8c8a093 length-ceiling construct is floor=hard). The difficulty comes from (a) five interdependent artifacts driven by one generator with an exact byte-for-byte contract (fixed-width padding, exact labels, blank lines, NPV rounding, single-line result, deterministic JPEG rendering, construct truncation); (b) adversarial hidden cases that force the generator to generalize: >10 sites exercising top-10 truncation, equal-count ties with alphabetical tie-break, negative-NPV invest=no/defer=yes, short length ceilings forcing heavy construct trimming, and distinct poster phrases each rendered byte-identically; (c) the agent must derive the exact layouts/algorithms from prose and reproduce reference output on every hidden config, with no hardcoding of visible values possible.
